$schema_note: The ONE list of FRED series the site pulls every weekday (scripts/fetch-rates.mjs → the `rates` table) and reads back (lib/live-rates.ts → the rates strip on /tools and /market, and the seeds that pre-fill a calculator field). Both sides import this file, so the cron and the page cannot disagree about what a series is. `id` is the key in the `rates` table; `fred` is the FRED series it is fetched from where that differs (a `_YOY` id stores FRED's own percent-change-from-a-year-ago transform, `units: pc1`, so an index never reaches the page as a level). `unit` says what the stored figure is: `pct` a rate (shown 4.94%, moves in bps), `spread` a spread quoted in percent points (shown as bps), `pts` a share or a change (shown 2.9%, moves in points), `count` thousands of units at an annual rate (moves in percent). `freshDays` is one full publication cycle plus its release lag plus margin — see lib/live-rates.ts for why it is per series. `contractRate` is the standing fact that a loan document names this rate; whether a card currently takes it is the page's own list. Every entry here was verified from the runner: a series is added only once a dry run of the rates workflow has printed its FRED title and a current observation.
